programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
Snow Leopards with Dan ONeill 1 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.

Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.

Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.

Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: 紮根 #4
Rooted 1 #4
programme.desc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上.它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境.

The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall ...

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #8
Tales from Zambia 2 #8
programme.desc: 樹木是非洲最古老的居民,每棵樹木都有自己在旱季生存的戰略.臘腸樹和無花果樹在季節性極端情況下,向掙扎求存的動物提供食物和住所,共度時艱.作為回報,動物通過幫花卉授粉和分散種子來幫助這些樹木繁殖.非洲樹木促進生命,並成為地球上最珍貴生態系統之一的支柱.

Trees are Africas oldest residents, and each has its own strategy for surviving the dry season. The sausage tree and the fig tree ride-out seasonal extremes, to provide food and shelter for struggling animals in the lean times. In return animals ...

programme.title: 啄木鳥:樹洞故事
Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: 伴隨著一個獨特的鳥類家族的穩定鼓點行進.了解為何世界上從大到小的239種啄木鳥都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠們的飛行、攀爬和呼叫技能;進入牠們的秘密巢穴一探究竟.

March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.

Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
My Best Friends An Animal 2 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷.和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水.

Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #2
Battle of the Alphas 1 #2
programme.desc: 澳洲擁有各種別樹一幟的生物,成功成為王者的方式也同樣多樣性.海灘變成決鬥場,內陸成了拳擊場,動物們同室干戈.

Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a dueling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind.

My Best Friends An Animal 2 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.

Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #1
Africas Hunters 1 #1
programme.desc: 本集跟隨一隻老邁的豹子三天,她正努力覓食,同時試圖避開惡魔般的鄰居:一個清道夫獅子群.

A revolutionary thermal camera reveals the secret world of nocturnal predators. Follow along as one of the oldest-known leopards struggles to survive her fearsome neighbors: a pride of scavenging lions.

programme.title: 月球野性面 #3
Wild Side of the Moon 1 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程.看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲.

Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
The Kimberley: Australias Wild West 1 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食.在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義.

Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: 紮根 #5
Rooted 1 #5
programme.desc: 這是令人難以置信關於一棵樹的故事,它已存活了八百多年...能抵受最惡劣的環境...而且昆蟲、鳥類和動物更喜歡它...巨大的猢猻樹.它紮根於津巴布韋南部的馬里蘭威禁獵區的大草原.

This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years… that can withstand the harshest conditions… and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other…the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Mal...

programme.title: 海洋饕餮盛宴 [英/普]
The Oceans Greatest Feast [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 前排觀看地球上最大規模的生物量遷移,即每年沿南非東海岸1000英里的沙丁魚風暴.數十億條小魚倉皇躲避著饑餓的捕食者,其中包括隱秘的海豹和潛水炸彈般的塘鵝.

Get a front-row seat to the planets biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africas east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: 祕「蜜」日記 [英/普]
A Bees Diary [Eng/Man]
programme.desc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事.
In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #3
Battle of the Alphas 1 #3
programme.desc: 非洲大草原有著史詩式的景致,無論是砸頭的河馬、荷爾蒙失調的大象還是決鬥的獅子,席捲大草原的戰鬥都同樣是史詩式的.
The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether its head-bashing hippos, hormone-crazed elephants or dueling lions, battles that rage on the savanna are just as epic.

programme.title: 肯亞野生日記 #1
Kenya Wildlife Diaries 1 #1
programme.desc: 尼華保育區正在努力讓大象由肯雅山經過桑布魯國家公園回到野外.他們還創造了一個大象禁區,試圖恢復受損的生態系統.無線電跟蹤項圈用於幫助環保學家更好地瞭解大象的需求,並觀察牠們是否正返回棲息地.

Lewa Conservancy is working to return elephants to territory from Mt. Kenya to Samburu National Park. Theyve also created an elephant exclusion zone to try and restore a damaged ecosystem. Radio tracking collars are used for both initiatives to h...

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #1
Undiscovered Vistas 2 #1
programme.desc: 瞭解世上最大的火山島,一個孤獨而崎嶇不平的地方,蒸汽散逸,水花四濺,每天都有新土地誕生.且看冰火交融如何打造地球上最強大的地質島嶼.

Learn about the worlds largest volcanic island, a lone and rugged place where steam escapes, water explodes, and new ground is born every day. See how fire and ice collide in a battle that makes this the most geologically powerful island on earth.

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #2
Undiscovered Vistas 2 #2
programme.desc: 遊覽從前由冰雕鑿而成,現在則是由火山建構的島嶼.大約150萬年前,一塊冰地從北而下並覆蓋了整片土地.時至今日,巨大的冰川仍繼續一邊雕刻著海洋懸崖,一邊砍伐山脈.

Tour an island built by volcanoes, but sculpted by ice. About 1.5 million years ago, a sheet of ice descended from the north and covered the land. Today, massive glaciers continue to carve marine cliffs and cut down mountains.

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #3
Undiscovered Vistas 2 #3
programme.desc: 走進芬迪灣洶湧的水域.瞭解這個東岸生態系統如何維持眾多生物,當中包括成千上萬的海鳥,世上最快的捕食者,以及複雜的無脊椎動物網絡.

Step into the Bay of Fundys surging waters. Learn how this east coast ecosystem sustains an abundance of creatures, including hundreds of thousands of seabirds, the worlds fastest predator, and a complex web of invertebrates.

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #4
Undiscovered Vistas 2 #4
programme.desc: 沿著大不列顛島的西海岸,世上最長的無間斷步道穿越超過800英里的壯麗景色.威爾斯海岸的多樣化景觀簡直是地質瑰寶.

Travel along the west coast of Great Britain, where the worlds longest uninterrupted footpath forges through more than 800 miles of breathtaking scenery. This majestic coast teems with wildlife, geological mysteries, and centuries of human history.

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #5
Undiscovered Vistas 2 #5
programme.desc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟.它被大西洋、莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑.

Explore an island surrounded by the mighty Atlantic ocean, subjected to pounding waves and driving rain. From the Cliffs of Moher to the Giants Causeway, this land has been shaped and reshaped by the power of water and violent geological forces.

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #6
Undiscovered Vistas 2 #6
programme.desc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌.從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地.

Journey to the wild Pacific coast on the western shore of Vancouver Island in British Columbia. From the peaks of mountain glaciers to the canopies of Canadas only rainforest, nature and human spirit coexist in spectacular habitats.

programme.title: 紮根 #1
Rooted 1 #1
programme.desc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壯麗的駱駝刺樹.這棵相思樹已經在此屹立了兩個世紀.在這片乾旱的地貌中,這棵駱駝刺樹是大大小小生物的避難所.善於交際的織布鳥、綠豆象甲蟲和各種哺乳類動物在喀拉哈里活用這棵標誌性的樹.

Across rippled dunes, in the wind-swept grasslands of the southern Kalahari towers a magnificent Camelthorn. It has stood here for two centuries. This tree is never lonely, learn how it provides food, shelter and a hunting ground to many creatures.

programme.title: 紮根 #2
Rooted 1 #2
programme.desc: 這是備受喜愛的香腸樹的浪漫故事.博茨瓦納東北角的塞林達保護區面臨艱難的一年.它十分乾旱,雨季還有幾個月才來到.在如此具有挑戰性的期間,許多鳥類和動物依靠香腸樹來維持生計.

Discover the story of the much loved Sausage Tree, whose nectar filled blooms and sausage shaped fruits entice animals of all kinds, from insects to elephants. See how the very animals who rely on this generous tree ensure its proliferation.

programme.title: 紮根 #3
Rooted 1 #3
programme.desc: 索特潘斯山脈的高山地雨林中生長出巨大的奧特尼夸香槐樹.這是一個講述了這棵巨大的樹如何在她的枝梢中提供居所、飼養和庇護一眾動植物的故事.

In a misty South African forest grows a six hundred year old Outeniqua Yellowwood. At forty meters tall, she towers above the canopy and is one of the few remaining of her kind. Follow her captivating story, unique as the ecosystem in her branches.

programme.title: 紮根 #4
Rooted 1 #4
programme.desc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上.它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境.

The Namaqua Rock Fig Tree stands rooted on the slope of a rocky hill in Namaqualand, South Africa. It is the ultimate survivor, able to withstand the unforgiving conditions in a landscape facing ever rising temperatures and less and less rainfall ...

programme.title: 紮根 #5
Rooted 1 #5
programme.desc: 這是令人難以置信關於一棵樹的故事,它已存活了八百多年...能抵受最惡劣的環境...而且昆蟲、鳥類和動物更喜歡它...巨大的猢猻樹.它紮根於津巴布韋南部的馬里蘭威禁獵區的大草原.

This is the incredible story of a tree that has been around for eight hundred years… that can withstand the harshest conditions… and that is more loved by insects, birds and animals than any other…the enormous Baobab. Rooted on the savannah of Mal...

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰
Boss Shark
programme.desc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王.一起為群雄的速度、獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采.

Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #1
Super Shark Highway 1 #1
programme.desc: 來到澳洲南部水域,展開一場具挑戰性的追蹤任務,並揭示鯊魚的食物來源和他們聚集於覓食熱點的原因.團隊之後一路向北,追蹤虎鯊、公牛鯊和錘頭鯊,並為他們其中一員裝上360度的背鰭攝像鏡頭.

Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #2
Super Shark Highway 1 #2
programme.desc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地.然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情.

Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #3
Super Shark Highway 1 #3
programme.desc: 與位處北方的科學家團隊一起熬夜,他們嘗試為一隻公牛鯊裝上追蹤儀,看看這頭夜貓子入夜後有何行蹤.然後與南方團隊一起潛入80米深的海底,並嘗試為一條雌性大白鯊裝上衛星追蹤器.

Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #4
Super Shark Highway 1 #4
programme.desc: 跟隨北方研究團隊窺探鯊魚的社群層級結構,他們正在研究年輕的黑鰭鯊如何學習社交和生存技能.然後與南方團隊會合,一同前往彩虹海灘,他們渴望目睹沙虎鯊最難以捉摸的行為:交配.

Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger sharks most elusive behaviour: mating.

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #5
Super Shark Highway 1 #5
programme.desc: 探索澳洲超級鯊魚大道的盡頭,了解南方的格林利島是否大白鯊遷徙路線的中途站,然後尋找北方牛鯊與生活在較冷氣候的表親,以及他們之間的基因聯繫證據.

Travel to the ends of Australias shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #6
Super Shark Highway 1 #6
programme.desc: 跟隨南方團隊測試新的追蹤鯊魚技術和工具,可望減少在熱門浮潛地點的鯊魚攻擊.然後與北方團隊一起追蹤牛鯊;科學家們希望幫助當地游泳者避開即將分娩的母牛鯊.

Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰
Boss Shark
programme.desc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王.一起為群雄的速度、獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采.

Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.title: 大白鯊的秘密
Secrets Of The Great White Shark
programme.desc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

programme.title: 下一站:緬甸
Destination Myanmar
programme.desc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #1
New York Gourmet #1
programme.desc: 準備好迎接一場史詩般的紐約美食大探險吧!賈斯汀(Justine)來到 Russ Daughters 品嚐招牌貝果,沉浸在德卡爾布市場(DeKalb Market)充滿活力的熱鬧氛圍中,並大口享用經典的紐約切片披薩.這為終極的美食冒險拉開了激動人心且風味十足的序幕!

Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #2
New York Gourmet #2
programme.desc: 味蕾之旅大爆發!賈斯汀探索了美國烹飪學院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐廳品嚐了融合加勒比海與美國南方風味的大膽創意料理,並買了香甜的義大利奶油甜餡煎餅卷(cannolis).在風景如畫的白脫牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐後,她前往傳奇的 Moose

The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essies, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #3
New York Gourmet #3
programme.desc: 一場狂野的市場之旅正等著您!賈斯汀一頭栽進鹽城市場(Salt City Market),在奧農達加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹調墨西哥捲餅,並大啖煙燻風味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉.最後,她在風景優美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生醬烤棉花糖巧克力夾心餅(sm

A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter smores in scenic Canandaigua!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #4
New York Gourmet #4
programme.desc: 美食驚喜持續不斷!賈斯汀將當地 Living Roots 酒莊的葡萄酒與豐盛的義式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣賞令人嘆為觀止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),並造訪指標性的 Anchor Bar,大口品嚐最正宗的水牛城辣雞翅!純粹的美味與令人驚豔的美景在此完美交會.

Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #5
New York Gourmet #5
programme.desc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符.

Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #6
New York Gourmet #6
programme.desc: 盛大的壓軸好戲火熱登場!賈斯汀在 Toad Hill 楓糖農場搭配新鮮糖漿製作了蘋果煎餅,接著大啖薩拉托加(Saratoga)炸雞,最後在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一頓令人難忘的最終盛宴,為她這場史詩般的紐約冒險帶來最完美的加冕!

The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

programme.title: 美味走透透:日本 #4
Destination Flavour: Japan #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明繼續他的日本烹飪朝聖之旅,品嚐一些最頂級的味噌、名古屋雞肉和和牛,並認識了一位年屆74歲的採鮑潛水員.
Adam Liaw continues his culinary pilgrimage in Japan, devouring some of the finest miso, Nagoya chicken and Wagyu beef, and meeting a 74-year-old abalone diver.

programme.title: 美味走透透:日本 #5
Destination Flavour: Japan #5
programme.desc: 廖崇明在東京廣闊的城市版圖中探索一種飲食文化,它不僅維持了「工薪族」的風格,還保留了其烹飪傳統.
In the vast urban sprawl of Tokyo, Adam Liaw explores a food culture that not only sustains the `salaryman workers in style but retains culinary traditions.

programme.title: 美味走透透:日本 #6
Destination Flavour: Japan #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明查訪了一些東京的瘋狂美食餐廳,品嚐了一些有趣的菜式,包括用雞的生殖器官製成的日式烤雞串.
Adam Liaw checks out the restaurants of food-crazy Tokyo and tastes some interesting dishes including Yakitori made from the reproductive organs of chickens.

programme.title: 美味走透透:日本 #7
Destination Flavour: Japan #7
programme.desc: 廖崇明在蓬勃發展傳統文化的京都遇到了一位茗茶大師、一位藝伎和一位將義大利飯變成壽司的米芝蓮大廚.
Adam meets a tea master, a Maiko, and a Michelin chef who turns risotto into sushi in the thriving traditional culture of Kyoto.

programme.title: 美味走透透:日本 #8
Destination Flavour: Japan #8
programme.desc: 廖崇明探索日本充滿活力的金融中心- 大阪,發現世上最好的快餐、一位相撲力士出身的大廚,以及味道令人死而無憾的蕎麥麵.
Adam Liaw explores Japans high-energy financial centre, Osaka, and finds the worlds best fast food, a sumo wrestler turned chef, and soba noodles to die for.

programme.title: 美味走透透:日本 #9
Destination Flavour: Japan #9
programme.desc: 在日本南部的九州和四國,廖崇明發現了一個充滿活力、溫馨的文化,該地的美食跟人民一樣迷人.
In Japans southern islands of Kyushu and Shikoku, Adam Liaw finds a vibrant, warm culture where the cuisine is as fascinating as its people.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #1
Ainsley Eats The Streets #1
programme.desc: 安斯利以伊斯坦堡作為旅程的第一站,他在當地見到慢烤羊頭,土耳其鄉村時令食物,如塞滿小茴香肉丸的枇杷,以及用嫩無花果燉的羊肉.

On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheeps head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #2
Ainsley Eats The Streets #2
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪加勒比海地區,他在後巷冒險尋覓真正的當地食物.他與當地人共度時光,和好味道先生在海灘上做煎餅和超讚的魚糕,並嘗試了有史以來最辣的辣醬.

Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #3
Ainsley Eats The Streets #3
programme.desc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食.他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕.

Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #4
Ainsley Eats The Streets #4
programme.desc: 安斯利的街頭美食長征於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.

Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #1
New York Gourmet #1
programme.desc: 準備好迎接一場史詩般的紐約美食大探險吧!賈斯汀(Justine)來到 Russ Daughters 品嚐招牌貝果,沉浸在德卡爾布市場(DeKalb Market)充滿活力的熱鬧氛圍中,並大口享用經典的紐約切片披薩.這為終極的美食冒險拉開了激動人心且風味十足的序幕!

Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #2
New York Gourmet #2
programme.desc: 味蕾之旅大爆發!賈斯汀探索了美國烹飪學院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐廳品嚐了融合加勒比海與美國南方風味的大膽創意料理,並買了香甜的義大利奶油甜餡煎餅卷(cannolis).在風景如畫的白脫牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐後,她前往傳奇的 Moose

The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essies, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #3
New York Gourmet #3
programme.desc: 一場狂野的市場之旅正等著您!賈斯汀一頭栽進鹽城市場(Salt City Market),在奧農達加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹調墨西哥捲餅,並大啖煙燻風味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉.最後,她在風景優美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生醬烤棉花糖巧克力夾心餅(sm

A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter smores in scenic Canandaigua!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #4
New York Gourmet #4
programme.desc: 美食驚喜持續不斷!賈斯汀將當地 Living Roots 酒莊的葡萄酒與豐盛的義式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣賞令人嘆為觀止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),並造訪指標性的 Anchor Bar,大口品嚐最正宗的水牛城辣雞翅!純粹的美味與令人驚豔的美景在此完美交會.

Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #5
New York Gourmet #5
programme.desc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符.

Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #6
New York Gourmet #6
programme.desc: 盛大的壓軸好戲火熱登場!賈斯汀在 Toad Hill 楓糖農場搭配新鮮糖漿製作了蘋果煎餅,接著大啖薩拉托加(Saratoga)炸雞,最後在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一頓令人難忘的最終盛宴,為她這場史詩般的紐約冒險帶來最完美的加冕!

The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

programme.title: 婆羅洲:祖傳森林
Borneo, The Ancestral Forest
programme.desc: 深入婆羅洲的心臟地帶,順著河流穿梭、翻山越嶺,探尋野生紅毛猩猩、侏儒象、長鼻猴、犀鳥與巨型昆蟲的蹤跡.這座島嶼擁有世界上最古老的原始熱帶雨林,以及極為豐富的生態系統.

A deep dive into Borneos heartland forest, traveling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and giant insects. This island harbors the worlds oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.

programme.title: 下一站:中國雲南 #1
Destination China: Yunnan #1
programme.desc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

programme.title: 下一站:中國雲南 #2
Destination China: Yunnan #2
programme.desc: 《下一站:中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家.
Destination China will take the audience to some of Yunnans most beautiful and stunning landscapes and homes to around 6000 species of plants, 200 mammals and 500 species of birds.

programme.title: 自然保護區 #1
Nature Sanctuaries #1
programme.desc: 領略納米比亞千公里的狂野海岸!乾旱沙漠中生命頑強綻放,本片捕捉了萬物在極端環境下生存的壯麗奇景.一同見證超越極限的生命之美!
Experience Namibias wild 1,000km coast! Where arid deserts meet stubborn life, this film captures a grandiose, fragile spectacle of nature thriving against all odds. Witness the impossible beauty!

programme.title: 自然保護區 #2
Nature Sanctuaries #2
programme.desc: 從落基山脈到太平洋,英屬哥倫比亞是生物多樣性的瑰寶!在遼闊大地追隨灰熊的霸氣身影.這是一片莊嚴且神聖、亟需我們守護的原始荒野!
From the Rockies to the Pacific, British Columbia is a jewel of biodiversity! Roam vast landscapes where the mighty grizzly bear reigns supreme. Its a majestic, wild world waiting to be preserved!

programme.title: 自然保護區 #3
Nature Sanctuaries #3
programme.desc: 生命自會找到出路!隨風漂流而來的物種,讓加勒比海成為全球生物多樣性熱點.深入探索這些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生態系,感受海島生機.

Life finds a way! Blown by winds and washed ashore, the Caribbean is now a mesmerizing hotspot of global biodiversity. Explore these fragile, emerald ecosystems and their incredible island resilience.

programme.title: 自然保護區 #4
Nature Sanctuaries #4
programme.desc: 穿越時空!探索昆士蘭古老的濕地與原生雨林.這裡棲息著史前時代的倖存者,帶您踏上一場通往熱帶澳洲起源的生命活力之旅.
Step back in time! Explore Queenslands ancient wetlands and primary rainforests. Home to survivors of prehistoric eras, its a vibrant journey to the very origins of tropical Australia.

programme.title: 大白鯊的秘密
Secrets Of The Great White Shark
programme.desc: 鯊魚是怪物嗎?還是已經被妖魔化?這部紀錄片探討大白鯊本性背後的真相.
Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

programme.title: 下一站:緬甸
Destination Myanmar
programme.desc: 《下一站:緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園.
Destination Myanmar will take the audience to some of Myanmars most beautiful and stunning Asian Heritage wetlands with fishermen paddling one-legged along shallow waters and floating gardens.

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #7
Wild Heroes #7
programme.desc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏.
Baby Giraffe meets the herd, the Zoos five otter brothers are on the move and the ectotherm team search for a hidden for a treasure.

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #8
Wild Heroes #8
programme.desc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務.
This time on Wild Heroes, its an anxious time for Zoo vets as they work to save one of the most endangered birds on the planet, and the ectotherm team are on a mission in the wild South Island.

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #9
Wild Heroes #9
programme.desc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生.
This time on Wild Heroes, the Zoo welcomes two crocodiles to the Swamp Forest, the new South East Asia habitat opens and the team prepare for the birth of a baby southern white rhino.

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #6
Wild Heroes #6
programme.desc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物.
This time on Wild Heroes, the Ungulate team prepare for a birth, we meet one of the longest living animals and Auckland Zoo helps to save an endangered giant.

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #4
Wild Heroes #4
programme.desc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.

This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #2
Wild Heroes #2
programme.desc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.

Auckland Zoos vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

Secrets Of The Great White Shark

Reptiles, amphibians, insects and fish are found in every corner of our world - and for this special group of animals, life is regulated by the sun.

Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essies, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #5
New York Gourmet #5
programme.desc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符.

Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

programme.title: 賀錦麗:明日傳奇
Kamala Harris: The Next President
programme.desc: 本紀錄片探討賀錦麗從早年加州的生活到成為首位美國女性副總統的崛起經過、她對美國政壇的影響以及她有望成為首位女總統的潛力.

This documentary explores Kamala Harriss rise from her early life in California to becoming the first female Vice President of the United States, her impact on American politics, and her potential path to becoming the first female President.

programme.title: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
Denzel Washington: American Icon
programme.desc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力.
This in-depth documentary explores the remarkable journey of Denzel Washington, a powerhouse actor who has redefined what it means to be a leading man in Hollywood.

A deep dive into Borneos heartland forest, traveling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and giant insects. This island harbors the worlds oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.

Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

programme.desc: 安斯利的街頭美食長征於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬.

Ainsleys street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

Ainsley Eats The Streets #5
programme.desc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食.他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食.

Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the islands unique recipe for pesto.

This in-depth documentary explores the remarkable journey of Denzel Washington, a powerhouse actor who has redefined what it means to be a leading man in Hollywood.

With over 50 years in the industry, not many filmmakers can boast the longevity and influence of Steven Spielberg, whose journey from the suburbs of Arizona to the spotlight of Hollywood is one of the greatest stories ever told.

Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

Edge Of Existence #3
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們.人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.

programme.desc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.
This episode explores the worlds most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #7
Wildest Survival #7
programme.desc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠「交談」.
In this episode we explore animal communication and reveal the incredible adaptations that enable animals to talk to each other.

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9
Wildest Survival #9
programme.desc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢.
Showcasing some of natures most incredible animal minds, whose brains demonstrate high intelligence, enabling them to gain advantage of their competition.

Ainsley Eats The Streets #6
programme.desc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮台灣大蝦.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #7
Ainsley Eats The Streets #7
programme.desc: 安斯利發現馬德里是個充滿秘密的城市.首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食.那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?
Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #8
Ainsley Eats The Streets #8
programme.desc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩、混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.

Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

The Moviemakers #2

programme.title: 電影大師 #3
The Moviemakers #3
programme.desc: 自90年代初,昆汀塔倫提諾一直乘坐從不減速的電影過山車,這也鞏固了他那世上最具影響力的電影製作人之一的地位.
Since the early 1990s, Quentin Tarantino has been on a cinematic rollercoaster ride, thats never looked like slowing down, that has cemented himself as one of the worlds most influential filmmakers.

programme.title: 電影大師 #4
The Moviemakers #4
programme.desc: 史派克李一直是位備受爭議和政治性的電影製作人,他的電影就是最好的證據.自40多年前處女作面世,他一直在美國突破界限.
Spike Lee has always been a controversial and political filmmaker whose films speak for themselves. Over 40 years since his debut in the world of film, Spike continues to push boundaries in America.

programme.title: 碧昂絲:鄉村音樂女王
Beyonce: Queen Country
programme.desc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合「天命真女」主唱到現在的單飛生涯.探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的.

Follow the life and career of Beyoncé Knowles-Carter, from her early days as the lead singer of Destinys Child to her solo career. Discover how the superstars music style and inspirations have developed over the years.

programme.title: 珍娜·傑克森:誘惑的藝術
Janet Jackson: The Art Of Seduction
programme.desc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性、有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峰.

Noted for her fierce independence, her magnetic aura and her ever so charming voice, Janet Jackson became a catalyst for her growth on MTV; embracing her identity, and reaching up to the heights of stardom.

programme.title: 山繆傑克森:給我聽好
Samuel L. Jackson: Did I Stutter?
programme.desc: 憑藉無出其右的職業道德,山繆傑克森作為電影史上最傑出人物之一的地位毋容置疑.這位仍然擄獲全球粉絲的心的漫威演員,一起跟進他的傳奇.

With a work ethic like no other, its hard to doubt Samuel L. Jacksons status as one of the most prominent figures in cinematic history. Follow the legend of the marvel actor as he continues to capture the hearts of fans all world the over.

programme.title: 李小龍:戰士之道
Bruce Lee: The Way Of The Warrior
programme.desc: 李小龍,荷里活電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友.《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇.

Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend. The Way of the Warrior takes a comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him.

programme.title: 阿姆斯壯
Armstrong
programme.desc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性、感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾岩士唐最完整的人生故事—從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月—以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.

Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

The Presidents #1
programme.desc: 祖拜登於2021年1月20日就任美國第46任總統,承諾在分裂的時代後團結和鎮靜,目標是「恢復美國魂」.
Joe Biden became the 46th US President on Jan 20, 2021, promising unity and calm after a divided era, aiming to restore the soul of America.

programme.title: 碧昂絲:鄉村音樂女王
Beyonce: Queen Country
programme.desc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合「天命真女」主唱到現在的單飛生涯.探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的.

Follow the life and career of Beyoncé Knowles-Carter, from her early days as the lead singer of Destinys Child to her solo career. Discover how the superstars music style and inspirations have developed over the years.

programme.title: 珍娜·傑克森:誘惑的藝術
Janet Jackson: The Art Of Seduction
programme.desc: 珍妮積遜以其強烈的獨立性、有吸力的氣質和迷人的嗓音而聞名,她在MTV的成長成為她的催化劑;接受她的身份,並到達明星的巔峰.

Noted for her fierce independence, her magnetic aura and her ever so charming voice, Janet Jackson became a catalyst for her growth on MTV; embracing her identity, and reaching up to the heights of stardom.

programme.title: 山繆傑克森:給我聽好
Samuel L. Jackson: Did I Stutter?
programme.desc: 憑藉無出其右的職業道德,山繆傑克森作為電影史上最傑出人物之一的地位毋容置疑.這位仍然擄獲全球粉絲的心的漫威演員,一起跟進他的傳奇.

With a work ethic like no other, its hard to doubt Samuel L. Jacksons status as one of the most prominent figures in cinematic history. Follow the legend of the marvel actor as he continues to capture the hearts of fans all world the over.

programme.title: 李小龍:戰士之道
Bruce Lee: The Way Of The Warrior
programme.desc: 李小龍,荷里活電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友.《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇.

Bruce Lee, an iconic figure in Hollywood cinema, a pioneer of martial arts but most importantly, a friend. The Way of the Warrior takes a comprehensive look at the legend that is Bruce Lee, told by the people closest to him.

programme.title: 阿姆斯壯
Armstrong
programme.desc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性、感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾岩士唐最完整的人生故事—從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月—以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位.

Dramatic, moving and insightful, Armstrong tells the definitive life story of Neil Armstrong - from his childhood in rural Ohio, through aerial combat in Korea, to his first steps on the Moon - and the unwanted celebrity status that ensued.

programme.title: 自然之聲 #1
Sounds Of Nature #1
programme.desc: 傾聽大自然隱藏的聲音.跨越五大洲,全球專家從婆羅洲的森林到玻里尼西亞的大海,追蹤令人驚嘆的聲學信號,探索我們生命生態系統中無與倫比的聲音景觀.

Listen to the hidden sounds of nature. Across five continents, world experts track surprising acoustic signals from Borneos forests to Polynesias seas, exploring the incredible soundscape of our living ecosystems.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #8
Ainsley Eats The Streets #8
programme.desc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩、混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.

Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #9
Ainsley Eats The Streets #9
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品.
Ainsley visits Georgetown, the capital of Penang island, where Malaysians come to discover the best street food in this food-obsessed country.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #10
Ainsley Eats The Streets #10
programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #2
Edge Of Existence #2
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.

Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #3
Edge Of Existence #3
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們.人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.

Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #1
Edge Of Existence #1
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #1
New York Gourmet #1
programme.desc: 準備好迎接一場史詩般的紐約美食大探險吧!賈斯汀(Justine)來到 Russ Daughters 品嚐招牌貝果,沉浸在德卡爾布市場(DeKalb Market)充滿活力的熱鬧氛圍中,並大口享用經典的紐約切片披薩.這為終極的美食冒險拉開了激動人心且風味十足的序幕!

Get ready for an epic NY food quest! Justine hits Russ Daughters for iconic bagels, soaks in the vibrant buzz of DeKalb Market, and devours a classic slice of New York pizza. A thrilling, flavor-packed kickoff to the ultimate culinary adventure!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #2
New York Gourmet #2
programme.desc: 味蕾之旅大爆發!賈斯汀探索了美國烹飪學院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐廳品嚐了融合加勒比海與美國南方風味的大膽創意料理,並買了香甜的義大利奶油甜餡煎餅卷(cannolis).在風景如畫的白脫牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐後,她前往傳奇的 Moose

The flavor journey explodes! Justine explores the Culinary Institute, tastes bold Caribbean-Southern fusion at Essies, and grabs sweet cannolis. After a scenic picnic at Buttermilk Falls, she dines at the legendary Moosewood Restaurant!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #3
New York Gourmet #3
programme.desc: 一場狂野的市場之旅正等著您!賈斯汀一頭栽進鹽城市場(Salt City Market),在奧農達加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹調墨西哥捲餅,並大啖煙燻風味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉.最後,她在風景優美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生醬烤棉花糖巧克力夾心餅(sm

A wild market tour awaits! Justine dives into Salt City Market, cooks lakeside burritos at Onondaga Lake, and feasts on smoky Dinosaur BBQ. She tops off this mouthwatering day with gooey peanut butter smores in scenic Canandaigua!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #4
New York Gourmet #4
programme.desc: 美食驚喜持續不斷!賈斯汀將當地 Living Roots 酒莊的葡萄酒與豐盛的義式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣賞令人嘆為觀止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),並造訪指標性的 Anchor Bar,大口品嚐最正宗的水牛城辣雞翅!純粹的美味與令人驚豔的美景在此完美交會.

Gourmet thrills roll on! Justine pairs local Living Roots wines with hearty polenta, takes in breathtaking Niagara Falls, and visits the iconic Anchor Bar to devour the original Buffalo wing! Pure flavor meets jaw-dropping sights.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #5
New York Gourmet #5
programme.desc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符.

Justine tackles a classic roast beef lunch in Buffalo before setting sail for the magnificent 1000 Islands and Boldt Castle! Cooking and exploring along scenic waters, she caps off an unforgettable day at the luxurious Sagamore Resort.

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #6
New York Gourmet #6
programme.desc: 盛大的壓軸好戲火熱登場!賈斯汀在 Toad Hill 楓糖農場搭配新鮮糖漿製作了蘋果煎餅,接著大啖薩拉托加(Saratoga)炸雞,最後在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一頓令人難忘的最終盛宴,為她這場史詩般的紐約冒險帶來最完美的加冕!

The grand finale sizzles! Justine whips up apple pancakes with fresh syrup at Toad Hill Maple Farm, digs into Saratoga fried chicken, and crowns her epic New York adventure with an unforgettable final feast at River Market Bar and Kitchen!

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #1
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #1
programme.desc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味.他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿.

Bens food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #2
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #2
programme.desc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒.他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家.

Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #3
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #3
programme.desc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種.他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處.班追隨注重自耕蔬果的「土壤姐妹」運動.

Its asparagus season – Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the Soil Sisters a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #4
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4
programme.desc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠.他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!
Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #5
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #5
programme.desc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師.班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務.

Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #6
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #6
programme.desc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術.他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源.
Ben experiences the art of cheese making. He meets a capsicum producer and learns about the provenance of the onion.

The Presidents #2

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #3
The Presidents #3
programme.desc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望、正義、寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人.
Barack Obama, the 1st African-American US President, embodied hope, justice, tolerance, and equality, inspiring millions with his message and legacy.

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #4
The Presidents #4
programme.desc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞、彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響.
Explore Bill Clintons complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

Bens food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #2
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #2
programme.desc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒.他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家.

Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #3
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #3
programme.desc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種.他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處.班追隨注重自耕蔬果的「土壤姐妹」運動.

Its asparagus season – Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the Soil Sisters a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #4
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4
programme.desc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠.他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!
Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #5
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #5
programme.desc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師.班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務.

Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #6
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #6
programme.desc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術.他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源.
Ben experiences the art of cheese making. He meets a capsicum producer and learns about the provenance of the onion.

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #1
The Humboldt Current #1
programme.desc: 在智利托雷斯德爾潘恩,雪山融水注入指狀峽灣,延伸至海洋並匯入洋流,降低海水鹽度.河口、濕地孕育眾多涉禽,而無數海灣與港口則吸引稀有的海豚與虎鯨.

In Chiles Torres del Paine melt from snow-covered mountains feeds finger-like fjords as they reach out to the sea to join the current lowering its salinity. Rivers estuaries and wetlands are home to many wading birds and the countless inlets and bay

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #2
The Humboldt Current #2
programme.desc: 洪堡洋流雖比多數洋流緩慢,卻是世界上最具活力的洋流之一,因其行經距離極長.深海海溝的湧升流將養分帶至海面,使浮游植物大量繁盛,奠定複雜海洋食物鏈的基礎.

The Humboldt Current is slower than most ocean currents but its the most dynamic in the world because it travels for such a long distance. Upwelling from the deepest trenches brings nutrients to the surface allowing phytoplankton to bloom laying the

programme.title: 洪堡涼流 #3
The Humboldt Current #3
programme.desc: 這股洋流伴隨著智利獨特的藍鯨族群,也是其他極度稀有海洋哺乳動物的最後避風港.從冰冷深海到高崖強風,洋流塑造出奇特棲地,也是一部關於生存的自然研究.

The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #10
Ainsley Eats The Streets #10
programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #1
Destination Flavour: China #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅.
Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #2
Destination Flavour: China #2
programme.desc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.

Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #3
Destination Flavour: China #3
programme.desc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.

Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #4
Destination Flavour: China #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化、國際化、全球化的城市.
Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #1
Edge Of Existence #1
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼.
Edge of Existence examines existential threats to the worlds biosphere and what it means for the future of the planet, and Aotearoa.

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #2
Edge Of Existence #2
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.

Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #3
Edge Of Existence #3
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們.人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.

Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves #7
programme.desc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾.托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像.
In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves #8
programme.desc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來.在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟.
The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

programme.title: 前進宇宙:太空、競賽、火星與更遠之處
Into the Cosmos: The Space Race, Mars And Beyond
programme.desc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力.
A look at the development of space travel and the potential for humans to one day walk on the surface of Mars.

programme.title: Minecraft:創新革命
Minecraft: The Next Revolution
programme.desc: 2009 年 5 月,麥克斯·「Notch」·佩爾森(Markus Notch Persson)推出了一款名為《麥塊》(Minecraft)的獨立小品遊戲.憑藉直覺式的玩法與無窮的創造力,它一路席捲全球,從一個簡單的個人副業計畫,蛻變為史上最暢銷的電子遊戲,成就一段震撼全球的驚人現象!

In May 2009, Markus Notch Persson launched a humble indie game named Minecraft. With intuitive play and infinite creativity, it became the best-selling video game of all time—evolving from a simple side project into a massive global phenomenon!

programme.title: PlayStation 的故事
The Story Of Playstation
programme.desc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作.但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機.Playstation從此屹立不倒.

With video-games on the rise, Sony, the tech superpower would attempt a collaboration with Nintendo. After a shocking betrayal, Sony founded what would become the worlds most successful chain of video game consoles. The Playstation was here to stay.

programme.title: 任天堂的故事
The Story Of Nintendo
programme.desc: 由製造「花札」卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平台.這就是任天堂的故事.

From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #4
The Presidents #4
programme.desc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞、彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響.
Explore Bill Clintons complex legacy, from Arkansas roots to White House highs (economic prosperity) and lows (scandals, impeachment), and his impact on American politics.

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #5
The Presidents #5
programme.desc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭、其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡.
Documentary examines George W. Bushs presidency, focusing on the Iraq War, its aftermath, and the lasting impact of his decisions, including the rise of ISIS and the human toll of the conflict.

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #6
The Presidents #6
programme.desc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義.
Ronald Reagan, a charismatic leader, transformed America with Reaganomics, dividing opinion at home and abroad, and forever changing Conservatism with his visionary policies and iconic speeches.

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #2
Air Warriors S11 #2
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.

This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

programme.title: 自然保護區 #5
Nature Sanctuaries #5
programme.desc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #1
Wildest Survival #1
programme.desc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, natures most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #5
Ainsley Eats The Streets #5
programme.desc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食.他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食.

Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the islands unique recipe for pesto.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #6
Ainsley Eats The Streets #6
programme.desc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一.他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮台灣大蝦.

Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #7
Ainsley Eats The Streets #7
programme.desc: 安斯利發現馬德里是個充滿秘密的城市.首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食.那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?
Ainsley discovers that Madrid is a city of secrets. The first one comes as a bit of a shock: street food is banned in this food-obsessed city. So how do the locals get round this?

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #8
Ainsley Eats The Streets #8
programme.desc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩、混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.

Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #9
Ainsley Eats The Streets #9
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品.
Ainsley visits Georgetown, the capital of Penang island, where Malaysians come to discover the best street food in this food-obsessed country.

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #10
Ainsley Eats The Streets #10
programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #1
Destination Flavour: China #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅.
Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #2
Destination Flavour: China #2
programme.desc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉.徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成.

Adam visits the beautiful, mountainous province of Anhui, home to one of the eight great regional cuisines of China. Anhui cuisine is hearty, peasant food that uses seasonal, wild produce from the mountains.

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #3
Destination Flavour: China #3
programme.desc: 崇明繼續透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程,他到訪江蘇省和浙江省,它們也位列中國八大菜系之中,並以其豐盛和精緻而聞名.

Adams journey to explore Chinas history through its food continues, as he visits the provinces of Jiangsu and Zhejiang, both considered part of the 8 great regional cuisines of China and celebrated for their wealth and sophistication.

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #4
Destination Flavour: China #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化、國際化、全球化的城市.
Adam Liaw arrives in one of the largest cities in the world Shanghai where he discovers a modern, cosmopolitan and global facing city.

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #1
Destination Flavour: China #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅.
Adam Liaw arrives in his mums home town of Beijing to begin a culinary, historical and personal journey through the ancient country of China.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #1
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #1
programme.desc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味.他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿.

Bens food story journey starts in the deep south where he learns why lamb tastes so good. He meets the earliest pioneers producing truffles and travels by helicopter into Fiordland in search of Wapiti.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #2
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #2
programme.desc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒.他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家.

Ben travels to Northland and learns about wine in the region. He discovers a peanut farm, meets tropical papaya fruit growers and catches up with a team of scientists cultivating kingfish like never before.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #3
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #3
programme.desc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種.他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處.班追隨注重自耕蔬果的「土壤姐妹」運動.

Its asparagus season – Ben picks the 3 varieties. He meets a farmer and understands the benefits of grass-fed beef. Ben catches up with the Soil Sisters a movement focussed on growing your own fruit and vegetables.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #4
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #4
programme.desc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠.他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!
Ben checks out a sustainably farmed Green Shell Mussel Farm and visits a peanut butter factory. He travels to Canterbury to meet an ostrich farmer and cooks ostrich for the first time ever!

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #5
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #5
programme.desc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師.班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務.

Ben meets a Gin maker, an Italian chacutier and celebrates a wine maker committed to the principles of sustainable farming. Ben milks sheep and learns how next generation farmers are diversifying their business.

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #6
A New Zealand Food Story S3 #6
programme.desc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術.他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源.
Ben experiences the art of cheese making. He meets a capsicum producer and learns about the provenance of the onion.

programme.title: 自然之聲 #1
Sounds Of Nature #1
programme.desc: 傾聽大自然隱藏的聲音.跨越五大洲,全球專家從婆羅洲的森林到玻里尼西亞的大海,追蹤令人驚嘆的聲學信號,探索我們生命生態系統中無與倫比的聲音景觀.

Listen to the hidden sounds of nature. Across five continents, world experts track surprising acoustic signals from Borneos forests to Polynesias seas, exploring the incredible soundscape of our living ecosystems.

programme.desc: 傾聽大自然隱藏的聲音.跨越五大洲,全球專家從婆羅洲的森林到玻里尼西亞的大海,追蹤令人驚嘆的聲學信號,探索我們生命生態系統中無與倫比的聲音景觀.

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #3
Wildest Survival #3
programme.desc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況、飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #5
Wildest Survival #5
programme.desc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.
This episode explores the worlds most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #7
Wildest Survival #7
programme.desc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠「交談」.
In this episode we explore animal communication and reveal the incredible adaptations that enable animals to talk to each other.

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9
Wildest Survival #9
programme.desc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢.
Showcasing some of natures most incredible animal minds, whose brains demonstrate high intelligence, enabling them to gain advantage of their competition.

programme.title: 自然保護區 #5
Nature Sanctuaries #5
programme.desc: 國土雖小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加擁有全球 5% 的物種.從山巔到海岸,親身體會守護這座豐富生命聖殿對地球是多麼至關重要.
Small country, massive impact! Costa Rica hosts 5% of all Earths species. Trek from peaks to shores to see why protecting this rich, living sanctuary is an absolute necessity for our planet.

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #1
Wildest Survival #1
programme.desc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, natures most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #16
Below Deck Down Under S4 #16
programme.desc: 一個不再是秘密的吻讓船上的關係陷入嚴重緊張,其後果導致一名船員被剝奪了階級徽章.
A not-so-secret kiss puts relationships onboard under serious strain, with consequences that leave one crew member stripped of their stripes.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #17
Below Deck Down Under S4 #17
programme.desc: 在一名船員降職後,另一名船員爭取晉升.班大廚晉升艾莉的計劃引發了他與黛西之間的緊張關係.
In the wake of one crew members demotion, another pushes for a promotion. Chef Bens plan to promote Ellie stirs tension with Daisy.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #18
Below Deck Down Under S4 #18
programme.desc: 傑森船長在最後一次航程前向各部門主管劃清界線.一位再次到訪的包船客人讓後廚團隊大感棘手.船員們依依惜別.
Capt. Jason draws a line in the sand with his HODs before the final charter. A returning charter guest proves difficult for the galley team. The crew says goodbye.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #1
Below Deck Down Under S4 #1
programme.desc: 傑森船長與主廚本、黛西及若昂重聚,迎接來自《鹽湖城真實人妻》嘉賓的高壓首航.
As Capt. Jason reunites with Chef Ben, Daisy and Joao for a high-pressure opening charter with The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #2
Below Deck Down Under S4 #2
programme.desc: 隨著「人妻」們的衝突持續升溫,傑森船長保持距離,而廚房日益增長的壓力使主廚本與阿萊西亞產生了矛盾.
As housewives drama continues to boil over, Capt. Jason keeps his distance while mounting pressure in the galley puts Chef Ben and Alesia at odds.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #3
Below Deck Down Under S4 #3
programme.desc: 傑森船長引入了匿名賓客意見卡,全體船員一同慶祝破紀錄的小費金額.
Capt. Jason introduces anonymous guest feedback cards and the crew celebrates a record-breaking tip.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #4
Below Deck Down Under S4 #4
programme.desc: 船員大洗牌激發了珍娜的嫉妒心,也讓主廚班在廚房裡分了心.
A crew shakeup fuels Jennas jealousy and distracts Chef Ben in the kitchen.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #5
Below Deck Down Under S4 #5
programme.desc: 主廚班因賓客的毒舌評論而大受打擊,他在廚房過度補償,並因無線電溝通不良與黛西發生衝突.
Reeling from harsh guest feedback, Chef Ben overcompensates in the galley and clashes with Daisy over radio miscommunication.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #6
Below Deck Down Under S4 #6
programme.desc: 當艾蕾西亞急忙想掩埋一則令人後悔的簡訊時,八卦散播的速度快到讓她無法招架.
As Alesia scrambles to bury a regrettable text, gossip spreads faster than she can contain it.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #7
Below Deck Down Under S4 #7
programme.desc: 烤箱損壞迫使主廚班在極大壓力下,挑戰製作一套包含七道菜的晚餐.
A broken oven forces Chef Ben to attempt a seven-course dinner under extreme pressure.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #9
Below Deck Down Under S4 #9
programme.desc: 當主廚班與艾莉在緊張的晚餐服務中發生爭執時,傑森船長要求全體保持專業態度.
Capt. Jason demands professionalism when Chef Ben and Ellie clash through a tense dinner service.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #10
Below Deck Down Under S4 #10
programme.desc: 廚房的和平是有代價的,主廚班推出了一項「親暱稱呼罰金制」以控制緊張局勢.
Peace in the galley comes at a price when Chef Ben introduces a pet-name penalty to keep tensions in check.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #11
Below Deck Down Under S4 #11
programme.desc: 儘管有艾蕾西亞在其中作梗,珍娜和艾迪最終還是回到了彼此的身邊.
Jenna and Eddy find their way back to each other despite Alesias meddling.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #12
Below Deck Down Under S4 #12
programme.desc: 在包船賓客留下驚喜禮物並提出大膽的「加碼小費」挑戰後離船,傑森船長終於准許船員們享受一場期待已久的假.
After charter guests depart with a surprise gift and a daring offer for extra tip money, Capt. Jason grants the crew a long-awaited day off.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #13
Below Deck Down Under S4 #13
programme.desc: 主廚班開始覺得黛西不再支持他了.
Chef Ben begins to feel Daisy no longer has his back.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #14
Below Deck Down Under S4 #14
programme.desc: 主廚班和珍娜試圖讓他們的曖昧關係更進一步,但艾迪的嫉妒和麥克的干擾卻成了絆腳石.
Chef Ben and Jenna try to take their flirtations to the next level, but Eddys jealousy and Mikes interference get in the way.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #15
Below Deck Down Under S4 #15
programme.desc: 新空服員(或二副/服務員)的到來讓珍娜的嫉妒心徹底爆發.黛西和艾莉因為鮮蝦沙拉發生的爭吵,讓主廚班夾在中間進退兩難.
The arrival of a new stew pushes Jennas jealousy into overdrive. A fight between Daisy and Ellie over shrimp cocktail puts Chef Ben in the middle.

programme.desc: 一個不再是秘密的吻讓船上的關係陷入嚴重緊張,其後果導致一名船員被剝奪了階級徽章.
A not-so-secret kiss puts relationships onboard under serious strain, with consequences that leave one crew member stripped of their stripes.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #17
Below Deck Down Under S4 #17
programme.desc: 在一名船員降職後,另一名船員爭取晉升.班大廚晉升艾莉的計劃引發了他與黛西之間的緊張關係.
In the wake of one crew members demotion, another pushes for a promotion. Chef Bens plan to promote Ellie stirs tension with Daisy.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #18
Below Deck Down Under S4 #18
programme.desc: 傑森船長在最後一次航程前向各部門主管劃清界線.一位再次到訪的包船客人讓後廚團隊大感棘手.船員們依依惜別.
Capt. Jason draws a line in the sand with his HODs before the final charter. A returning charter guest proves difficult for the galley team. The crew says goodbye.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #1
Below Deck Down Under S4 #1
programme.desc: 傑森船長與主廚本、黛西及若昂重聚,迎接來自《鹽湖城真實人妻》嘉賓的高壓首航.
As Capt. Jason reunites with Chef Ben, Daisy and Joao for a high-pressure opening charter with The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #2
Below Deck Down Under S4 #2
programme.desc: 隨著「人妻」們的衝突持續升溫,傑森船長保持距離,而廚房日益增長的壓力使主廚本與阿萊西亞產生了矛盾.
As housewives drama continues to boil over, Capt. Jason keeps his distance while mounting pressure in the galley puts Chef Ben and Alesia at odds.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #3
Below Deck Down Under S4 #3
programme.desc: 傑森船長引入了匿名賓客意見卡,全體船員一同慶祝破紀錄的小費金額.
Capt. Jason introduces anonymous guest feedback cards and the crew celebrates a record-breaking tip.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #4
Below Deck Down Under S4 #4
programme.desc: 船員大洗牌激發了珍娜的嫉妒心,也讓主廚班在廚房裡分了心.
A crew shakeup fuels Jennas jealousy and distracts Chef Ben in the kitchen.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #5
Below Deck Down Under S4 #5
programme.desc: 主廚班因賓客的毒舌評論而大受打擊,他在廚房過度補償,並因無線電溝通不良與黛西發生衝突.
Reeling from harsh guest feedback, Chef Ben overcompensates in the galley and clashes with Daisy over radio miscommunication.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #6
Below Deck Down Under S4 #6
programme.desc: 當艾蕾西亞急忙想掩埋一則令人後悔的簡訊時,八卦散播的速度快到讓她無法招架.
As Alesia scrambles to bury a regrettable text, gossip spreads faster than she can contain it.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #7
Below Deck Down Under S4 #7
programme.desc: 烤箱損壞迫使主廚班在極大壓力下,挑戰製作一套包含七道菜的晚餐.
A broken oven forces Chef Ben to attempt a seven-course dinner under extreme pressure.

programme.title: 澳洲遊艇 4 #9
Below Deck Down Under S4 #9
programme.desc: 當主廚班與艾莉在緊張的晚餐服務中發生爭執時,傑森船長要求全體保持專業態度.
Capt. Jason demands professionalism when Chef Ben and Ellie clash through a tense dinner service.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 #8
Cobra Kai S3 #8
programme.desc: 得知本年度全谷空手道大賽被取消後,三位師父齊聚市議會,努力爭取比賽繼續舉行.
Informed that this years All Valley Karate Tournament is being canceled, the three competing sensei attend a city council meeting to save it.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #1
Cobra Kai S5 #1
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的新盟友(後轉為室友)考驗著阿曼達的耐心.米格爾在墨西哥尋找親生父親.泰瑞則開始對「眼鏡蛇道館」進行大改造.
Daniels new ally-turned-housemate tests Amandas patience. Miguel searches for his father in Mexico. Terry starts to transform Cobra Kai.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #2
Cobra Kai S5 #2
programme.desc: 喬善和丹尼爾策劃了一個針對泰瑞的冒險計畫.在墨西哥,羅比和強尼正在尋找米格爾,而米格爾發現了關於他父親的真相.
Chozen and Daniel hatch a risky plot against Terry. In Mexico, Robby and Johnny look for Miguel, who discovers the truth about his dad.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #3
Cobra Kai S5 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾過去的另一個敵人重新浮出水面.經過一天的 SPA 水療和一番內心掙扎後,珊對於她與米格爾的未來做出了決定.
Another enemy from Daniels past resurfaces. After a spa day and some soul-searching, Sam comes to a decision about her future with Miguel.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #4
Cobra Kai S5 #4
programme.desc: 強尼和卡門的情事進展順利,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則被泰瑞的陰謀搞得心神不寧.青少年們的恩怨延燒到了水上樂園.
Johnny and Carmens romance flies high while Daniel and Amanda are rattled by Terrys schemes. The teens feuds spill over at the waterpark.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #5
Cobra Kai S5 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼爾依靠一位朋友——也是「亦敵亦友」的夥伴.米格爾和羅比的緊張關係達到頂點.一張熟悉的面孔回歸了.
Daniel leans on a friend – and frenemy. Tensions come to a head for Miguel and Robby. A familiar face returns.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #6
Cobra Kai S5 #6
programme.desc: 泰瑞招募了一位精通「拳法之道」的專家.丹尼爾選擇遠離紛爭,強尼和喬善卻主動挑起戰火.在監獄裡,克里斯正視著內心的心魔.
Terry recruits an expert in the way of the fist. Daniel walks away from a fight, and Johnny and Chozen pick one. In prison, Kreese confronts old demons.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 5 #7
Cobra Kai S5 #7
programme.desc: 泰瑞和金發起了一項殘酷的挑戰,而喬善則教導他的學生們不同的一課.強尼和丹尼爾要求克里斯給出交代.
Terry and Kim issue a brutal challenge while Chozen teaches his students a different kind of lesson. Johnny and Daniel demand answers from Kreese.

programme.desc: 一套尚未經測試的全球防禦系統引發毀滅性的太陽閃焰,造成災難性地震與狂暴的磁暴;史無前例的 CAT.8 級末日浩劫.人類能否阻止全面滅絕?

programme.desc: 一場難得的家庭聚會為塔姆拉帶來了歡樂,但一場瘋狂的夏威夷烤肉派對卻引發了徹底的混亂!艾蜜莉和珍因為薇琪的暴怒而與她對峙,結果薇琪卻把目標轉向卡蜜拉.見證卡蜜拉展現出全新且更為強悍的一面!

Cobra Kai S5 #9

The Librarian: The Curse Of The Judas Chalice
programme.desc: 因為在拍賣會上取得魔法的「賢者之石」而忽略女友,弗林・卡森因此被命令去度假.來到紐奧良後,他卻忙於保護「猶大聖杯」,並試圖阻止吸血鬼威脅世界.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 #8
Cobra Kai S6 #8
programme.desc: 一場個人危機深深震撼了米格爾和強尼.喬善和一名敵對教練聯手尋找他們的學生,卻意外發現了別的事物.
A personal crisis shakes Miguel and Johnny to the core. Chozen and a rival sensei team up to find their students - but discover something else instead.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 #9
Cobra Kai S6 #9
programme.desc: 在錦標賽的雙打淘汰賽中,誰能晉級下一輪:宮城道館還是眼鏡蛇道館?一個震驚的啟示擊碎了丹尼爾的世界.
Who will move to the next round in the tournaments tag team elimination match: Miyagi-Do or Cobra Kai? A shocking revelation shatters Daniels world.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 #10
Cobra Kai S6 #10
programme.desc: 丹尼爾和強尼將充滿歷史氣息的巴塞隆納作為隊長們的訓練場.但在準決賽中的一次陰險偷襲,引發了一場空前絕後的大混戰.
Daniel and Johnny use historic Barcelona as a training ground for their captains. But a cheap shot in the semifinals sparks a brawl to end all brawls.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 #11
Cobra Kai S6 #11
programme.desc: 當學生們在規劃告別空手道後的生活時,丹尼爾和強尼因重振「世界大會」而發生衝突.克里斯則重新審視了他的指導原則.
While their students plan for life after karate, Daniel and Johnny clash over reviving the Sekai Taikai. Kreese reconsiders his guiding principles.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 #12
Cobra Kai S6 #12
programme.desc: 珊和羅比在為未來的挑戰進行訓練時,向朋友們尋求支持.強尼和卡門迎來了隊伍的新成員.
Sam and Robby turn to their friends for support as they train for the challenges ahead. Johnny and Carmen welcome a new addition to the team.

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 #13
Cobra Kai S6 #13
programme.desc: 當真相時刻來臨,丹尼爾和強尼勇敢面對過去.接著來到了戰鬥時間,羅比將在世界空手道錦標賽中對決阿塞爾.
As the moment of truth arrives, Daniel and Johnny confront their pasts. Then its fight time as Robby battles Axel in the world karate championship.

programme.title: 似曾相識
Somewhere In Time
programme.desc: 一名劇作家沉迷於一張1912年美麗女演員的照片,並透過自我催眠穿越時空回到過去尋找她.
A playwright becomes obsessed with a photograph of a beautiful young actress from 1912 and travels back through time using self-hypnosis to find her.

programme.title: 藝伎回憶錄
Memoirs Of A Geisha
programme.desc: 被賣入京都殘酷的娛樂區,一名少女學會了誘惑、虛榮與競爭,最終成為日本最傑出的藝妓.在華麗絲綢與白粉面具之下,藏著一場危險的生存遊戲,以及一場足以毀滅一切的禁忌之戀.

Sold into Kyotos ruthless pleasure district, a young girl masters seduction, vanity, and rivalries to become Japans supreme geisha. Beneath silk and powder lies a dangerous game of survival and a forbidden desire that could destroy it all.

programme.title: 太極張三豐
Tai Chi Master
programme.desc: 兩位昔日少林僧人好友,因卷入反叛政權的動亂而分道揚鑣.雄心勃勃者步步高升,成為權傾一時的軍官;而被背叛的朋友則修習太極之道,追尋內心的平靜與力量.

Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of Tai Chi.

programme.title: 47浪人
47 Ronin
programme.desc: 基努李維主演《47浪人》,這是一部史詩奇幻電影,講述一名被放逐的浪人加入武士行列,為了對抗殘暴的領主、尋求復仇與榮耀,在古代日本展開驚心動魄的旅程.
Keanu Reeves stars in 47 Ronin, an epic fantasy where an outcast joins samurai on a quest for vengeance and honor against a ruthless overlord in ancient Japan.

programme.title: 烽火芳菲
The Chinese Widow
programme.desc: 1941年,轟炸東京後,一名美國飛行員在中國緊急降落.一位當地寡婦救了他,並冒著生命危險將他藏匿起來,以免他被日軍抓獲.
In 1941, after bombing Tokyo, a US pilot makes an emergency landing in China. A local widow rescues him and risks everything to hide him from Japanese forces.

programme.title: 精武英雄
Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: 1937 年,一名中國武術家重返上海,發現師父遇害、武館遭日軍欺壓,於是挺身而出.
In 1937, a Chinese martial artist returns to Shanghai to find his teacher dead and his school harassed by the Japanese.

programme.title: 大地雄獅
Lion Of The Desert
programme.desc: 這部史詩級歷史劇講述了真實存在的貝都因人領袖奧瑪·繆克泰爾的故事.他在20世紀初英勇地率領利比亞本土抵抗軍,對抗墨索里尼統帥下殘暴且武器精良的義大利入侵軍隊.

An epic historical drama depicting the real-life Bedouin leader Omar Mukhtar, who bravely leads the Libyan native resistance against the brutal, technologically superior forces of Benito Mussolinis invading Italian army in the early 20th century.

programme.title: 穆荷蘭大道
Mulholland Dr
programme.desc: 一位充滿希望的洛杉磯女演員與一位失憶女子結為好友.當她們共同尋找她身份的過程中,現實與幻覺交織,這是一場如夢似幻,關於野心,身份與好萊塢黑暗面的驚悚之旅.

A hopeful actress in Los Angeles befriends an amnesiac woman, and as they search for her identity, reality and illusion blur in a dreamlike thriller about ambition, identity, and Hollywoods dark side.

programme.title: 撲克臉 2 #6
Poker Face S2 #6
programme.desc: 查理被捲入中學課室的政治鬥爭,一場無傷大雅的才藝表演被一名學生與班級寵物有關的邪惡陰謀搶去焦點.
Charlie gets caught up in the politics of an elementary school classroom when a harmless talent show performance is upstaged by a students diabolical plot involving the class pet.

programme.title: 撲克臉 2 #7
Poker Face S2 #7
programme.desc: 查理與一家大型存倉商店的經理來了一場浪漫喜劇式初見,但她的新歡被指控策劃了搶劫商店的黑色星期五利潤,她必須查出真相.

Charlie has a classic rom-com meet-cute with a big box store manager, but when her new beau is accused of masterminding the heist of the stores Black Friday profits, its up to her to figure out what happened.

programme.title: 末日光明 [PG15] #7
See [PG15] #7
programme.desc: 雙胞胎在前往啟明之家中途遇到人生交叉點.
The twins reach a crossroads in their journey to the House of Enlightenment.

programme.title: 秘夜組織 #2
Talamasca: The Secret Order #2
programme.desc: 蓋伊加入了塔拉馬斯卡,並被派往倫敦執行首次任務.海倫負責訓練他成為間諜.
Guy joins Talamasca and is sent to London on his first mission. Helen trains him to be a spy.

programme.title: 秘夜組織 #3
Talamasca: The Secret Order #3
programme.desc: 蓋伊對塔拉馬斯卡的信任產生了懷疑.海倫向蓋伊講述了「七五二」的故事.
Guy questions his trust in the Talamasca. Helen tells Guy the story of the Seven Five Two.

programme.title: 秘夜組織 #2

Guy questions his trust in the Talamasca. Helen tells Guy the story of the Seven Five Two.

programme.title: 神之塔2 #17
Tower of God S2 #17
programme.desc: 獲得登船證的參賽者們在阿基米德號上稍作休息.坤在船上與拉克重逢.他們決心從FUG手中奪回維奧萊(巴姆),「旗幟」工坊之戰終於打響!

The participants that acquired boarding passes enjoy a moments rest aboard the Archimedes. Khun is reunited with Rak on the floating ship. With their determination to take back Viole (Bam) from FUG, the Flag Workshop Battle finally begins!

programme.title: 神之塔2 #18
Tower of God S2 #18
programme.desc: 遊戲一開始,王楠,王子和阿克拉普託就被迫與被維爾迪的能力逼瘋的米森戰鬥.他們無法與米森溝通,該如何阻止她的暴走?

As soon as the game begins, Wangnan, Prince, and Akraptor are forced to fight against Miseng, who has been driven mad by Verdis ability. Unable to communicate with Miseng, how will they stop her rampage?

programme.title: 虛空魔境2 #2
Radiant S2 #2
programme.desc: 塞斯啟程前往首都,卻被一艘商人的飛艇攔截.多虧格林的幫助,塞斯才僥倖逃脫,並成功抵達首都,在那裡他遇到了道克和梅莉.
Seth sets out for the capital but gets intercepted by a Merchant-Baron airship. Seth barely escapes thanks to Grimm, and successfully reaches the capital where he encounters Doc and Melie.

programme.title: 虛空魔境2 #3
Radiant S2 #3
programme.desc: 塞斯試圖進入城堡的檔案館,結果被趕了出來!之後,塞斯結識了奧科霍,並與她並肩作戰.
After attempting to enter the castles archives, Seth gets kicked out! Seth is later introduced to Ocoho and joins her in battle.

programme.title: 虛空魔境2 #4
Radiant S2 #4
programme.desc: 賽斯和奧科霍與強大的幽靈復仇者幫展開對決,同時試圖保護一個小農場免於破壞.
Seth and Ocoho face off against a powerful Spectral Nemesis band while attempting to protect a small farm from destruction.

programme.title: 魔鬼孩子王
Kindergarten Cop
programme.desc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在魔鬼孩子王中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子.這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作,幽默和感人.

Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, its a classic comedy-thriller.

programme.title: 美國殺人魔
American Psycho [Extended Version]
programme.desc: 派屈克・貝特曼是一名在華爾街,於父親公司任職的年輕人,卻毫無理由地殺人.隨著日子一天天過去,他對世界的仇恨愈發強烈.這部極度黑暗的黑色喜劇改編自布雷特・伊斯頓・艾利斯的同名小說.

Patrick Bateman, a young man working on Wall Street at his fathers company kills for no reason at all. With each day, his hatred for the world becomes more and more intense. This incredibly dark comedy is based on the book by Bret Easton Ellis.

programme.title: 醉後末日
The Worlds End
programme.desc: 在 醉後末日中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰.導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷,幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗.

In The Worlds End, Simon Pegg and Nick Frost reunite for an epic pub crawl that turns into a fight for humanitys future. Director Edgar Wright delivers a hilarious mix of nostalgia, comedy, and sci-fi thrills.

programme.title: 天崩地裂
Dantes Peak
programme.desc: 皮爾斯・布洛斯南主演但丁峰,一座寧靜小鎮面臨甦醒火山帶來的熔巖末日.爆炸性的動作場面與緊張懸疑,讓這部災難驚悚片成為必看之作!
Pierce Brosnan stars in Dantes Peak, where a quiet town faces fiery doom from a reawakening volcano. Explosive action and suspense make this disaster thriller a must-see ride!

programme.title: 戰艦世紀
Battleship
programme.desc: 在戰艦世紀中,地球與強大的外星勢力展開一場橫跨海洋,天空與陸地的激烈戰鬥.由彼得·柏格執導,連恩尼遜,泰勒克奇與蕾哈娜領銜主演,呈現震撼爆炸級的海上動作鉅片.
In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.
